topic.title: Release notes for 0.2
topic.shortdesc: Readers can choose the version of the docs they read, staff can restyle the site and its PDFs from the admin console, and PDFs print with templates.

ul.li: The label beside the site title can now be a version picker. Readers select it to read the docs of another version; pages, navigation, search, images and PDFs follow their choice. See .

Staff choose what it offers under Site & access → Version picker in the admin console: nothing (the default), each reader's own version, one fixed version for everyone, or a list of versions to choose from. See .
Switching changes only the version. Products and features still come from the reader's entitlements.
New admin API route PUT /admin/api/repos/:id/versions, a versionPicker field in seed files, the repo.versions audit action and migration 011_version_picker, applied on start.

PDFs print with a template: standard, report, compact or handbook, with page size, margins, text size, cover, contents, chapter breaks, running header and footer and page numbers to adjust. Projects choose one with pdf in opend.config.yaml. See .

A new Appearance page in the admin console sets the site theme (eight colour presets or your own accents, fonts, corners, reading width, colour scheme and custom CSS) and the PDF template, with no rebuild. See .
New admin API routes GET and PUT /admin/api/appearance, and the audit actions settings.appearance.theme and settings.appearance.pdf.

Release lines by minor version: a repository can keep one live release per minor (0.22, 0.23) instead of per major, so each reader keeps the docs of their own 0.x minor, and the version picker serves the line of the version chosen. New admin API route PUT /admin/api/repos/:id/release-lines, a releaseLines field on POST /admin/api/repos and in seed files, the repo.release-lines audit action and migration 012_release_lines. See .
The version picker offers only listed versions that have a live release.
GET /api/v1/help/nav: the token reader's navigation, for apps that draw a help sidebar. See .
Context links for public sites, /context/app/key, that redirect to the topic. See .
GET /api/v1/nav no longer lists the navtitle of a topic the key's audience cannot see.

section.title: Upgrading from 0.1
section.p: Deploy the new image. The migration adds one column with the picker off, so readers see no change until staff turn it on. Sites keep their look until staff set a theme or template. See .
